lines.text: Many learners say: My neighbor is very sympathetic.
Better: My neighbor is very nice.
Sympathetic means feeling sorry for someone. Nice is friendly.

data.why: Sympathetic means feeling sorry for someone. Nice is friendly.

quiz.stem: My friend is kind and friendly. She is very ___.

native.tip: En anglais, “sympathetic” veut dire « compatissant ». Pour « sympathique », employez “nice”.

en.tip: In English, “sympathetic” means feeling sorry for others. For a friendly person, say “nice”.
en.caption: Do you say this? “My neighbor is very sympathetic.” In English, “sympathetic” means feeling sorry for others. For a friendly person, say “nice”. Say “My neighbor is very nice.” Listen to Carlos and repeat with him! More exercises in the Lexkite app.
